changelog:
Version 2.0.0 introduces major upgrades with dual reporting modes.

- Merged html-report and html-report-generator into a single skill.
- Added Simple mode: generates responsive, single-page HTML reports using Tailwind CSS and Mermaid for fast analysis.
- Added Complex mode: creates multi-page, fixed-size (1017×720px) HTML reports featuring 13+ SVG charts and Chrome screenshot support, tailored for formal presentations.
- Comprehensive documentation and templates for both modes now included.
- Robust error handling and downgrade strategies for both report types.
summary: Generate HTML visualization reports. Simple mode: single-page responsive (Tailwind+Mermaid). Complex mode: multi-page fixed 1017x720px with 13+ SVG charts and Chrome screenshot.
